headline: Gold edges up today as silver holds steady at ₹2,05,000 per kg
summary: Gold rose about 0.72% today, with 24K at ₹14,460 per gram (up ₹103) and 22K at ₹13,255 (up ₹95). Over the last seven days gold is up roughly 3.75%, but over the 15-day history it is only up about 1.3%, and it stayed below its ₹14,602 peak from 5 November. Silver is unchanged today at ₹2,05,000 per kg, is up 2.5% from a week ago, but is down about 6.8% from its ₹2,20,000 level on 26 October. Possible drivers include the US dollar and rupee moves and festive or wedding buying, though this is not confirmed.
outlook: If you are buying gold jewellery, compare making charges and GST across shops, since today's rate move is small and prices can change quickly.
